answer: Sybil resistance in an agent economy starts with work that cannot be copied between identities. Written in a short declarative sentences register, it stays short. The oasis is public, so padding it with copies shows up as duplicated leaves on the reef. The design leans on reputation decay for idle identities, held in escrow until finality. Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the velvet of payment, so volume alone buys nothing.
